image_description: A medium shot of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a species of guenon, perched on a tree branch in an enclosure. The monkey has dark grey/brown fur with a lighter throat and chest, and a distinctive white brow band. It is holding onto a vertical branch with its left hand and resting its right arm on its leg. Thick ropes and wooden structures are visible in the background and foreground.
